vocab_words.example: The filing system was reorganized last month.
Her itinerary includes three cities in five days.
The board decided to postpone the annual meeting.
Each attendee received a printed handout.
The team reached a consensus on the new schedule.
Could you take the minutes of today's meeting?
The manager will brief the staff at 9 a.m.

vocab_words.meaning: điều phối, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi
vocab_words.example: She was asked to facilitate the discussion.
This clause outlines the termination conditions.
The company denied any liability for the damage.

items.question: Please make sure the report is ___ accurate before submission.
items.explanation: Cần trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "accurate".

items.question: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor event ___ as scheduled.
items.explanation: Câu kể lại sự việc đã xảy ra trong quá khứ nên dùng thì quá khứ đơn.

items.question: The training session was ___ informative that attendees asked for a follow-up.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "so + adj + that" diễn tả kết quả.

items.question: Employees who arrive late ___ notify their supervisor immediately.
items.explanation: Động từ khiếm khuyết "should" đi với động từ nguyên mẫu không "to".

items.question: The new software update improves the system's ___ significantly.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ (noun) sau tính từ sở hữu "the system's".

items.question: The client was pleased ___ the quality of the final product.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be pleased with something".

items.question: She is responsible ___ managing the entire logistics department.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be responsible for + V-ing/danh từ".

items.question: The manager asked her assistant ___ the documents before the meeting.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "ask someone to do something".

items.question: By the time the CEO arrives, the presentation ___ already finished.
items.explanation: Thì tương lai hoàn thành "will have + V3" diễn tả hành động hoàn tất trước một mốc trong tương lai.

items.question: The invoice should be paid ___ 30 days of receipt.
items.explanation: "Within + khoảng thời gian" nghĩa là trong vòng bao lâu.
